sum: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp., together with its subsidiaries, develops and commercializes crop productivity solutions in Argentina, Brazil, the rest of Latin America, and internationally. It operates through Seed and Integrated Products, Crop Protection, and Crop Nutrition segments. The company offers biological crop nutrition products comprising seed inoculants under the Rizoliq and UHC brands, biofertilizers, and biostimulants; biocontrol products, including bionematicides, biofungicides, and bioinsecticides; crop nutrition and crop protection products, such as micro-beaded fertilizers and adjuvants; and seed germplasms, GMO and non-GMO traits, and ready-to-use seed treatment pack solutions for healthier and higher yielding crops. It also provides fungicide products under the Rizoderma brand; Rizofos for foliar applications; therapies, herbicides, and baits; and bio-inductors, crop health products, and biological and micro granulated fertilizers. In addition, the company licenses its HB4 seed trait for drought tolerance in wheat and soybean seeds. It sells its products to blue-chip companies and industry leaders, large distributors, co-ops, dealers, large farmers, and individual growers through distributors and dealers. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Rosario, Argentina.
ceo: Dr. Federico  Trucco Ph.D. (CEO & Executive Director)
